server/routine-schedules.ts.name: Schedule types
server/routine-schedules.ts.description: Defines once, daily, cron, interval and limit-reset schedules and computes their next occurrence.

server/routine-run-gate.ts.name: Run preparation gate
server/routine-run-gate.ts.description: Holds a queued run while its computer is made ready and reports when it can start.

server/routine-bounds.ts.name: Run clocks and limits
server/routine-bounds.ts.description: Counts active work time per run and stops runs over their limit or busy-wait ceiling.

server/routine-check-pacing.ts.name: Check pacing
server/routine-check-pacing.ts.description: Limits AI runs started by checks to 24 a day with one in flight and failure backoff.

server/routine-execution.ts.name: Run prompt builder
server/routine-execution.ts.description: Builds the do-this-now routine prompt with attachments and an untrusted previous-run carry-over.

server/routine-waits.ts.name: Run waits
server/routine-waits.ts.description: Tracks a run's open approval or question, excludes the wait from limits and ends unanswered approvals.

server/routine-health.ts.name: Routine health
server/routine-health.ts.description: Summarizes each routine's latest outcome and consecutive failures without names or output.

server/routine-holds.ts.name: Routine holds
server/routine-holds.ts.description: Turns routines off for a cause such as signed-out AI and restores them when the cause clears.

server/routine-failure-spacing.ts.name: Failure spacing
server/routine-failure-spacing.ts.description: Spaces out scheduled runs of a routine that keeps failing instead of switching it off.

server/routine-skips.ts.name: Counted skips
server/routine-skips.ts.description: Folds occurrences skipped for one cause into a single missed row with count and span.

server/routine-no-start.ts.name: No-start spacing
server/routine-no-start.ts.description: Spaces scheduled runs after a cloud computer repeatedly fails to start.

server/routine-requests.ts.name: Routine requests
server/routine-requests.ts.description: Applies a bot's create, update, pause, resume, run or delete request at once with an undo card and receipt.

server/app-triggers.ts.name: App event triggers
server/app-triggers.ts.description: Long-polls the connected-apps service, reconciles triggers and turns each app event into a merged routine run.

server/app-trigger-host.ts.name: App trigger wiring
server/app-trigger-host.ts.description: Wires app-event triggers into the server with routes, bot tools and chat receipts.

server/app-trigger-broker.ts.name: Event broker client
server/app-trigger-broker.ts.description: Calls the connected-apps service to poll events, list inventory and bind or remove triggers.

server/trigger-tools.ts.name: Trigger tool views
server/trigger-tools.ts.description: Shows a bot its schedules, webhooks and app events with redacted instructions and recent runs.

server/wait-host.ts.name: Wait host wiring
server/wait-host.ts.description: Posts fired waits into chats, starts follow-up runs and proves a follow-up continues its own wait.

server/notify.ts.name: Notification builder
server/notify.ts.description: Builds bounded notifications per kind, staying quiet for disabled bots and empty results.

server/mausbot-notifications.ts.name: Notification feed rules
server/mausbot-notifications.ts.description: Classifies notification kinds as needs-you or fyi so only fyi can be marked read from chat.

server/automation-reports.ts.name: Automation reports
server/automation-reports.ts.description: Posts a run's last reply to its chat unless it ends NOTHING NEW, and decides which runs need review.

server/automation-destinations.ts.name: Result destinations
server/automation-destinations.ts.description: Chooses the chat where a routine or outside event reports its runs.

server/active-routines-context.ts.name: Active routines context
server/active-routines-context.ts.description: Adds a bounded preview of a bot's own enabled automations to its prompt.

server/host/starter-routine-wake.ts.name: Starter routine wake
server/host/starter-routine-wake.ts.description: Wakes a plan-paused bot when its routine runs or is saved and tells the person once.

server/host/default-watch.ts.name: Default watch
server/host/default-watch.ts.description: Defines the Keep an eye on my day routine name, instructions and 15-minute interval.

server/host/routine-checks.ts.name: Routine checks
server/host/routine-checks.ts.description: Reads Gmail and Calendar without AI, keeps cursors, and hands only items needing judgement to one run.

server/host/check-plan.ts.name: Check planning
server/host/check-plan.ts.description: Plans which mail and meetings are new, clashing, due a reminder or need prep.

server/host/brief.ts.name: Daily brief
server/host/brief.ts.description: Keeps one edited brief card per day, notifies once per update and posts a morning brief at a set time.

server/host/check-back-host.ts.name: Check-back chat line
server/host/check-back-host.ts.description: Writes and rewrites the quiet activity line a check-back keeps in its conversation.

server/routes/check-backs.ts.name: Check-back routes
server/routes/check-backs.ts.description: Serves the bot's check_back tool route and the person's Cancel route.

server/read-and-draft.ts.name: Read-and-draft fence
server/read-and-draft.ts.description: Confines unattended runs to reads and one reply draft by refusing every other request.

server/board/dispatcher.ts.name: Board dispatcher
server/board/dispatcher.ts.description: Hands ready board items to free member bots and retries or fails unsettled ones.

packages/phone-protocol/src/waits.ts.name: Wait kinds
packages/phone-protocol/src/waits.ts.description: Defines the wait condition kinds and the 24 to 168 hour wait lifetime.

shared/waits.ts.name: Waits re-export
shared/waits.ts.description: Re-exports the wait kinds from the phone protocol package.

shared/check-back.ts.name: Check-back re-export
shared/check-back.ts.description: Re-exports check-back line types and limits from the phone protocol package.

packages/phone-protocol/src/routines.ts.name: Routine wire types
packages/phone-protocol/src/routines.ts.description: Defines routine, run status, trigger source, access and delivery types plus default run limits.

src/components/automations/AutomationPan.name: Automation panel
src/components/automations/AutomationPan.description: Shows one automation with status, recent runs and pause, edit, run, delete actions.

src/components/routines/RoutineList.tsx.name: Routine list
src/components/routines/RoutineList.tsx.description: Lists routines with next-run state, paused-bot notes and an on/off switch.

src/components/automations/LimitWarnings.name: Limit warnings
src/components/automations/LimitWarnings.description: Shows engines near their limit and moves due automations to after the reset.

src/components/automations/actions.ts.name: Automation actions
src/components/automations/actions.ts.description: Calls the routine and webhook routes to toggle, run and delete an automation.
